name: quantem-gpu-dev
description: Development tools for the WebGPU TypeScript sources and their contract tests; not part of the Python package. Install with `npm ci`.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch --isolatedModules --skipLibCheck --target ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM,DOM.Iterable --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --resolveJsonModule --types @webgpu/types $(node -p "require('./src/quantem/gpu/webgpu/sources.json').filter((path) => path.endsWith('.ts')).map((path) => 'src/quantem/gpu/' + path).join(' ')")
